proof_groups.grouping_reason: All three witnesses belong to the same straight-line insertion and use the same xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg split-and-reassembly family. One 3-witness group is minimal, permits reuse of the group-suffixed helpers, and is below max_witnesses_per_group=12.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove group-suffixed split and reassembly helpers by induction on prefix. Use the split helper for entail_wit_1, retaining the fresh node's two undefined stores as a frame and selecting the empty-prefix or nonempty-prefix spatial orp branch. For each return witness choose the first Coq-disjunction alternative, normalize its prefix equality, reassemble the prefix, updated predecessor/sentinel, fresh node, designated node, and suffix segment, and close xizi_dll.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: xizi_dll head (prefix ++ target :: suffix) entails the generated empty-prefix/nonempty-prefix spatial decomposition around target: in the empty case head links target and target links the suffix; in the nonempty case prefix=prefix0++[prev] and the result owns sentinel links, a prefix0 segment, prev links target, target links the suffix, and the suffix segment.

premises.premise: the target occurs at the stated prefix boundary in prefix ++ target :: suffix

Choose the first outer disjunct, rewrite prefix=prefix0++[prev], splice the prefix0 segment with updated prev links, fresh-node links, target links, and suffix segment, retain the sentinel links, and close xizi_dll.
